newsitem.title: USA: ITI Tech to acquire security systems maker.
newsitem.headline: ITI Tech to acquire security systems maker.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire for $19 million, CADDX-CADDI Controls Inc, a privately held Texas based manufacturer of hardwire electronic security systems.
CADDX-CADDI will be purchased from four shareholders, including the chairman of CADDX, Kenneth Lewis.
The transaction is expected to close April 30, 1997.
ITI Technologies is the parent of Interactive Technologies Inc, which designs and makes wireless security systems. It had revenues of $93.3 million in 1996 and has about 480 employees.

CADDX is a privately held company with headquarters and a manufacturing facility located in Gladewater, Texas. CADDX had revenues of about $17 million for its fiscal year ended August 31, 1996. More than 40 percent of its revenues are generated outside of North America. CADDX employs about 140 people in the Gladewater area.

"Today's announcement signals a major step that will strengthen ITI's position as a leader in the electronic security alarm industry," said Thomas Auth, chairman, president and chief executive officer of ITI Technologies.
Upon closing, CADDX will operate under the CADDX Controls Inc name as an ITI Technologies company.
